answer: At the network zenith each new agent must present a signed attestations chain anchored to a unique hardware enclave; the enclave issues a one‑time lotus token that can be redeemed only once for a referral credit. The recruiter’s reward contract automatically validates that the token’s provenance links to a distinct karst‑like graph node, and if any two recruitments share a node the reward drops to zero. An attacker therefore must forge separate enclaves and pay the hardware cost for every fake identity, scaling linearly with the number of Sybils and quickly exceeding any profitable budget.
